turns.assessment: All affected and protection-switched services share lightpath och49 from S12 to S15. Its S12 interface raised EQPT_TX_FAIL exactly when the S15 receiver raised OCH_LOS; receiver power and channel-monitor power subsequently disappeared. Unchanged amplifier telemetry argues against an OMS-wide plant or amplifier failure, while unchanged receive-side metrics at trx.och49.a argue against a whole-card failure. This is decisive evidence that the transmit laser at trx.och49.a failed.

proposals.rationale: Direct EQPT_TX_FAIL at the S12 transmitter coincides with far-end OCH_LOS and loss of received/channel-monitor power. The resulting loss of och49 explains every affected working path.
A failed card could suppress its transmitted channel, but the interface's receive monitoring remained unchanged rather than becoming silent, strongly disfavoring whole-card failure.
Channel-specific excessive attenuation could remove och49 without changing aggregate amplifier telemetry, but it does not account well for the explicit transmitter-failure alarm.
